title: Pixel Block Clear
description: Blast luminous pixel-art mosaics block by block—match vivid color clusters, trigger crisp chain clears, and watch every pixel artwork pop into confetti.
controls: Tap matching color pixel blocks or launchers to clear matching cubes from the board until the entire mosaic is gone.

zh-CN.title: 像素消除
zh-CN.description: 超解压像素画方块消除：点选同色像素块连消清屏，一格一格击碎缤纷像素图案，看着整幅画面清脆崩解。
zh-CN.controls: 点击底部对应颜色方块或发射位消除上方同色像素块，清空整幅像素图即可过关。
